### Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the proposed feature or protocol enhancement (e.g., AXI4-Stream bridge, QoS arbitration, multi-master crossbar).

### Architectural Motivation
Why is this enhancement valuable? What system-on-chip use case does it address?

### Proposed Design Details
Describe the module interface changes, channel timing requirements, and state machine modifications.
